Official JP version of Lime's new Reze doujin.

Please Support the official release: https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01632083.html

Lime's Note:
Thank you very much for your purchase.

For this release, I had the pleasure of illustrating "Reze" from *Chainsaw Man*.

The concept behind this project began with the idea of ​​creating something based on the pool scenes found in the original manga—specifically, I started with a casual thought along the lines of, "Why not put her in a competitive swimsuit?"

Since there was no pre-existing CG asset collection to work from, I crafted the entire storyline completely from scratch.

When I’m drawing a manga, my usual process involves first deciding on the opening and the ending; the panels in between are then largely determined by whatever mood strikes me at the moment.

As for the costume, she is wearing a Speedo "Fastskin" swimsuit. The color blocking on this particular model is exquisite; among the countless competitive swimsuits out there, this design remains my absolute favorite.

I found it quite challenging to figure out how to effectively visualize sexual acts taking place underwater, so I decided to forgo that element this time around—though it is certainly something I’d love to attempt in the future!
n: [Doujinshi] [PURPLE HAZE (Lime)] The Slut Girl 3nd Costume (Chainsaw Man)
